description: This file contains utility functions for loading and managing test projects and test files in the Playwright test runner, including project collection, test file loading, suite creation, filtering, and error handling.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used for organizing and filtering tests.

methods.name: collectProjectsAndTestFiles
methods.description: Collects project files and sets up project suites based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: loadFileSuites
methods.description: Loads test files into suites, manages dependencies, and checks for import errors.

methods.name: createRootSuite
methods.description: Creates the root suite with project and test filtering, sharding, and 'only' filtering.

methods.name: loadGlobalHook
methods.description: Dynamically loads a global setup hook from a specified file.

methods.name: loadReporter
methods.description: Dynamically loads a reporter implementation from a specified file.

methods.name: loadTestList
methods.description: Loads a list of tests from a file and returns a filter function for matching tests.
